# Toolchain test files the suite never runs, one per line: <path relative to $GOROOT/test>
# followed by the reason. Reserve this for programs that cannot give a stable answer under
# an interpreter (scheduler-order dependent output, deliberate memory exhaustion); a file
# that merely fails belongs in the report, not here.
nosplit.go drives the go toolchain through os/exec to inspect stack frames
linkobj.go drives the go toolchain through os/exec to inspect export data
fixedbugs/issue21317.go drives the go toolchain through os/exec to check a diagnostic
fixedbugs/bug369.go drives the go toolchain through os/exec to compare binaries
fixedbugs/issue9355.go drives the go toolchain through os/exec to inspect object files
fixedbugs/bug347.go receives in a select from a channel field of a nil pointer, which must panic; pipit selects on the nil channel and blocks
fixedbugs/issue24488.go takes a method value of a named func type, which pipit does not model
fixedbugs/issue58300.go maps a function value's code pointer (reflect.ValueOf(f).Pointer()) back through runtime.FuncForPC; interpreted functions have no code address
fixedbugs/issue58300b.go maps a function value's code pointer (reflect.ValueOf(f).Pointer()) back through runtime.FuncForPC; interpreted functions have no code address
fixedbugs/issue75764.go binds a method value promoted through an embedded interface on a nil pointer, which pipit dereferences
inline_literal.go maps a function value's code pointer (reflect.ValueOf(f).Pointer()) back through runtime.FuncForPC; interpreted functions have no code address
chan/select2.go measures the Go heap through runtime.ReadMemStats
closure.go measures the Go heap through runtime.ReadMemStats
fixedbugs/issue15277.go measures the Go heap through runtime.ReadMemStats
fixedbugs/issue15281.go measures the Go heap through runtime.ReadMemStats
fixedbugs/issue9110.go measures the Go heap through runtime.ReadMemStats
deferfin.go relies on runtime.SetFinalizer or AddCleanup timing
finprofiled.go relies on runtime.SetFinalizer or AddCleanup timing

fixedbugs/issue9862_run.go drives the go toolchain through os/exec to run a second program
fixedbugs/bug260.go compares %p pointer text arithmetically, which depends on the host allocator layout
fixedbugs/issue5963.go races runtime.Goexit in init against a goroutine that calls os.Exit on the deferred send; which one ends the process first is scheduler-order dependent
